chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to the officers of the armies.
ai.seo_question: What is the title of the first letter in Nahj al-Balagha addressed to military commanders?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a pivotal directive from Imam Ali (AS) during the Battle of Siffin, where he instructed commanders to maintain strict discipline and moral integrity amidst the chaos of war. It reflects the Shia emphasis on combining martial prowess with spiritual consciousness, ensuring that military actions remain aligned with divine justice rather than mere political expediency.
